text:
Nora (People Ops): Quick brainstorm  tiny idea: do a surprise "Omakase Snack Box" drop for new hires' 1-month milestone. curated snacks + a handwritten note + a tiny non-cash token. low touch, high delight. thoughts? :bento:
Kai (Supply Ops): love it. are we shipping or pick-up? shipping costs add up for remote folks.
Nora (People Ops): hybrid: pick-up for onsite, ship a mini flat-rate box for remote. keep value under $10 to avoid tax issues.
Dina (Finance): note: <$10 non-cash per person is fine but track per-person totals. confirm vendor pricing and shipping estimates. GL 4102.
Riley (Growth): could brand the note with a tiny code linking to a welcome shoutout on our recognition feed. trackers help measure impact.
Nora (People Ops): yes  plan: 150 boxes (100 onsite, 50 remote). vendor quote: $4.20/box assembled, but we can do a slim curated pack for $2.75/box + $80 assembly fee. shipping avg $3/remote. total est ~$560.
Dina (Finance): $560 > petty limit; submit /spend-approval. If we can cut remote or reduce items maybe under $500. Also need receipts and GL code.
Kai (Supply Ops): can cut to 120 boxes (90 onsite, 30 remote) to get cost ~ $420. vendor also offers volunteer kit for in-house assembly (saves $80).
Omar (Legal): privacy check: don't put any personal notes referencing protected info. use a short templated note and an opt-out for delivery to home addresses. also include "If you prefer digital only, select that on your onboarding checklist."
Nora (People Ops): good call. we'll add opt-out to the onboarding form and include a checkbox managers can flip.
recognition-bot: Reminder  please log any physical non-cash gifts via /recognize with tag #omakase-drop so entries go into payroll exports.
Riley (Growth): metrics question: how do we measure impact? quick QR on the postcard linking to a 1-question pulse: "Did this make your month?" 1-5 star.
Dina (Finance): fine but ensure the QR doesn't collect PII. keep it one-click feedback.
Kai (Supply Ops): logistics: assembly party option  volunteers fold, insert note + token, sticker seal. need 4 volunteers for 2 hours. I can run 2 volunteers.
Nora (People Ops): volunteers  I'll post sign-up. also want to include a tiny enamel sticker (token) that costs $0.30 each. That still keeps each under $5 (no tax).
Omar (Legal): stickers fine. note template: "Congrats on 1 month! We see you and appreciate your work. -Redwood" no personal roles or performance mentions.
Dina (Finance): action: Nora submit spend approval with options (vendor-assembled vs volunteer-assembled). include GL 4102. Also need to know shipping/fulfillment lead times.
Kai (Supply Ops): vendor lead time 7 business days. volunteer assembly lead 3 business days if we buy materials early. For remote we'll need addresses export; confirm opt-outs first.
Nora (People Ops): action items: 1) I'll add opt-out toggle to onboarding 2) Kai to order materials and vendor quotes 3) I'll draft spend request 4) Riley will build 1-click pulse QR 5) Dina to confirm approval path.
recognition-bot: Note  entries tagged #omakase-drop will appear in the monthly recognition CSV.
Riley (Growth): small promotional idea  a highlight post in #general with blurred photos (no names) to show culture impact. check opt-outs.
Omar (Legal): ok with blurred photos if we avoid naming people and have consent for any pictured faces.
Nora (People Ops): timeline: launch week July 6-10 for 1-month anniversaries. shipping cutoff June 28. If spend >$500 we'll wait on approvals.
Dina (Finance): I'll review the spend request today; if under $500 approve; otherwise route.
Nora (People Ops): thanks team  goal is tiny surprise that makes onboarding feel warm without heavy ops. will post updates after cost final. :sparkles:
